responsibility: Implements the GIMPLE conditional dead call elimination pass for errno-setting builtins. The pass recognizes builtin calls that are usually unnecessary for in-range arguments, synthesizes argument or result checks, shrink-wraps the original call behind rarely taken control flow, and when possible replaces the value-producing path with a target-supported internal function plus deferred errno setting; it therefore rewrites CFG, preserves SSA and virtual operands, and serves as the middle-end bridge between math builtin semantics, errno behavior, and internal-fn lowering.
